label: Have a chat
gesture: Shoulders square, hands down, a small conversational smile.
text: Shuffle up. There’s a dry bit of bench just here.

label: Introduce a list
when: A section enters focus. Use this for the “Reported here” tour step.
gesture: Open hand towards the list, with an easy turn of the head.
text: Here’s what birders have seen lately. Each row has a date and a checklist.

label: Flag a detail
when: Dates, qualifications and details that are easy to overlook.
gesture: Dot peers over her red glasses, one hand on the rim.
text: See the date? That’s when the gull was seen.

label: Count it out
when: Two checks, two values or a short sequence of instructions.
gesture: Dot counts on her fingers, eyes following the count.
text: Six days ago is when. Sixty is how many. Quite a crowd.

label: Slip in an aside
when: Optional flavour once the practical point is clear.
gesture: A cupped hand at her cheek and a sidelong glance.
text: Sixty gulls. I’d eat those chips somewhere else.

label: Hand it back
when: Choices, questions and the end of a tour.
gesture: Dot eases back, folds her arms and waits with a smile.
text: I fancy the redshank. What about you?
